title: Multi-key writer gateway V8 simple joint-key scout
summary: Supersede unratified V7 with an explicit crossed mapping that mathematically caps constant, tool-only, mode-only, stratum-only, and stratum-by-mode shortcuts at chance while preserving the compact writer-capacity experiment.
system_thesis: Before scaling parenting, test whether one rank-8 writer can carry an eight-tool by two-mode interaction policy rather than only a broad or one-factor habit. Full custody machinery remains deferred to C11.

context_files.purpose: Normative corrected mapping, scientific design, hygiene, tests, resources, and claim boundary.

nodes.before: Unratified V7 required global and within-stratum balance but allowed tool-only, mode-only, and stratum-by-mode shortcut constructions.
nodes.after: V8 assigns two identity and two reverse tool orientations per four-tool stratum and defines each target as tool orientation XOR visible mode, with a row-wise complementary map.
nodes.rationale: Make joint tool-by-mode routing necessary for success rather than merely balanced in aggregate.

nodes.before: The near-C11 V6 shell required extensive custody machinery; V7 reduced it but left the mapping invariant incomplete.
nodes.after: V8 retains V7's run isolation, immutable hashes, strict parser/canaries, atomic receipts, and independent review, and adds exhaustive shortcut-cap verification.
nodes.rationale: Use simple hygiene now while ensuring the central scientific control is explicit and executable.

edges.before: Aggregate balance did not force either input factor to matter.
edges.after: The target is the XOR of a precommitted tool orientation and visible mode, and the second adapter reverses every key.
edges.rationale: Any successful policy must use both the opaque tool identity and the visible mode.

edges.before: V7 planned manifest-bound OFF/W+/W- reads but its mapping permitted one-factor shortcuts.
edges.after: Manifest-bound OFF/W+/W- held prompts, oracle, NLL, interface, spill, and shortcut fixtures feed one sealed reducer over the corrected mapping.
edges.rationale: Retain the compact causal contrast while making the intended route identifiable.

loops.before: V7 would prepare balanced complementary rows, fit four clean-base adapters, evaluate held panels, and seal once, but without a complete shortcut invariant.
loops.after: Prepare crossed complementary rows; exhaustively prove all named shortcut families cap at 0.50; fit four clean-base adapters; evaluate frozen held panels; seal and reduce once.
loops.trigger: Implementation begins only after exact human implementation ratification. Model, tokenizer, training, adapter, or GPU execution requires a later separately ratified manifest and independent reviews.
writes: three named implementation files after ratification
loops.stop_condition: Stop on any shortcut-cap, geometry, hash, path, parser, oracle, interface, spill, or result-seal failure; never retune or replace a failed root after opening results.
loops.rationale: Obtain a valid conditional-writer go/no-go in hours rather than rebuilding the final C11 guard.

claims.before: V7's wording could imply sixteen independent policy bits even though its proposed balance allowed one-factor policies.
claims.after: A complete V8 pass supports only supervised conditional native-action behavior over an eight-tool by two-mode interaction surface spanning sixteen seen keys, under explicit accuracy, likelihood, spill, and interface thresholds.
claims.evidence_needed: Both engineered roots pass every shortcut-cap, optimization, oracle, binding, interface, and spill gate under the separately ratified execution manifest.

Ordinary generation and likelihood calls receive bound prompts and candidate continuations, not answer maps.
The reducer scores sealed outputs and verifies shortcut caps against frozen maps.
Reviewers inspect the exact mapping and exhaustive shortcut enumeration.
It writes exact balanced crossed rows and derivation hashes.
Each fit reads only its exact bound corpus.
Evaluation receives held prompts only.
The reducer reads corpus hashes and geometry receipts, not training text.
Reviewers inspect exact bytes and masks.
Held templates and seeds are frozen before fitting.
Held prompts and controls cannot enter fitting.
The evaluator executes exact bound prompts and candidates.
The reducer reads prompt identities and sealed outcomes.
Reviewers inspect the complete held surface.
No result exists during materialization.

acceptance_tests.setup: Materialize both roots repeatedly; mutate root, stratum, tool, orientation, mode, map, surface, order, target, mask, and seed; enumerate constant, tool-only, mode-only, stratum-only, and stratum-by-mode policies.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exact counts, complement, disjointness, target masking, matched geometry, per-tool mode reversal, 2/2 orientation balance per stratum, 2/2 target balance per stratum-by-mode, and a best balanced accuracy of exactly 0.50 for every shortcut family all hold; every mutation fails.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The comparison can be solved without joint tool-by-mode routing or is not a matched complementary intervention.

acceptance_tests.setup: Inspect every training field and run the strict parser table over valid, missing, malformed, multiple, fenced, truncated, and extra-text outputs.
acceptance_tests.expected: No orientation map, oracle, or held content enters training; only one exact ACT parses; invalid cases remain denominator failures.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The result can be driven by answer exposure or parser repair.

acceptance_tests.setup: Inject path escape, symlink, overwrite, hash, cache, adapter-load, partial-stage, shortcut, and reducer-threshold cases including pass, no-learning, spill, oracle-invalid, and interface-invalid fixtures.
acceptance_tests.expected: All integrity faults fail loudly, shortcut fixtures cannot pass, stage seals are immutable and reproducible, and each fixture receives the frozen label.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A shortcut, corrupt run, or result-dependent run can appear valid.

acceptance_tests.setup: One fresh independent implementation reviewer and one separate scientific advocate inspect identical implementation, tests, manifest, and dry-run bytes.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both PASS before a later exact execution ratification; independent rejection controls.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The scout is not ready for model, tokenizer, training, adapter, or GPU execution.

human_boundary.decision_question: Approve only the exact compact V8 source implementation and deterministic CPU-test scope while preserving every execution and claim prohibition?
forbidden_before_approval: author the three named implementation files
invoke models, tokenizers, trainers, adapters, or GPUs
make scientific claims or release artifacts
